Email.buttonFallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
Email.accountReason: We sent this email to {email} because of a request on your Sniptide account.

verify.subject: Verify your Sniptide email
verify.preview: Confirm this address to turn on email notifications. The link works for one hour.
verify.heading: Verify your email
verify.body: Confirm that {email} belongs to your Sniptide account.
verify.next: Once it's verified, you can choose which events also reach you by email in Settings.
verify.note: If you didn't ask for this email, you can ignore it. The link expires in one hour.

change.subject: Approve your Sniptide email change
change.preview: After you approve, we send a verification link to {newEmail}.
change.heading: Approve your email change
change.body: Someone asked to change the email of your Sniptide account from {email} to {newEmail}.
change.after: After you approve, we send a verification link to the new address. The change is complete once that link is opened.
change.note: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email and change your password. The link expires in one hour.

reset.subject: Reset your Sniptide password
reset.preview: The link works once, for one hour.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Use this link to choose a new password for your Sniptide account.
reset.after: The link works once, for one hour. Changing your password signs you out on every device.
reset.note: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

notification.privacy: To keep your pastes private, this email leaves out their titles, links and contents.
notification.reason: You get this email at {email} because you turned on email for {event} in your notification settings.

shared.subject: A paste was shared with you
shared.preview: Sign in to see who shared it and open it.
shared.body: Someone shared a paste with your Sniptide account. Shared with me lists it with the person who shared it.

burned.subject: Your burn after read paste was read
burned.preview: It moved to your trash, where you can restore it for 30 days.
burned.body: One of your burn after read pastes was opened, so its link stopped working. The paste is in your trash, and you can restore it from there for 30 days.

expiring.subject: Your paste expires soon
expiring.preview: Change its expiry before then to keep the link working.
expiring.body: One of your pastes expires within 24 hours. To keep its link working, open it and change when it expires.

views.subject: Your paste reached a view milestone
views.preview: Analytics shows which paste it was and where its views came from.
views.body: One of your pastes reached a new view milestone. Analytics shows which paste it was, its views over time and where they came from.
